text:
emma_csm: Kickoff: SilkRoad pilot

vikram_se: Quick Q — which cloud region are they in? will affect latency tests.

emma_csm: EU-west primary; staging in us-east. We'll recommend hosted for pilot.

leo_enablement: I'll run enablement. Suggest two short sessions: intro/runbook + eval design. Who from SilkRoad to invite?

emma_csm: PM (Nadia), infra lead (Marco), and one support SME.

rita_successops: Renewal risk note: budget approval scheduled for month-end. Add triggers: D10 <50% traffic OR eval score <70%. We'll send weekly traction to Nadia's exec.

vikram_se: Tech checklist:
- API key & allowlist
- anonymized sample transcripts (500 rows)
- golden-answer eval set
- staging replay (5k)
- p95 latency target: <380ms

onboard-bot: Meeting created: "SilkRoad Pilot Kickoff" 2024-08-12 10:00 PDT — invites sent.

emma_csm: Success criteria: integration completed; >=75% on evals; p95 <380ms; customer can run daily evals. D30 decision: go/no-go + recommended commercial path.

leo_enablement: I'll share runbook template and pre-read today.

vikram_se: I'll post curl examples and a minimal test harness tonight.

emma_csm: Owners: integration=vikram_se; enablement=leo_enablement; metrics=rita_successops; CSM=emma_csm.

emma_csm: Action recap: vikram test harness (EOD), leo runbook (today), rita dashboard draft (Wed), emma finalize agenda (EOD). Thanks team! :raised_hands:
file_note: customer named inside text; participants list only Redwood employees/bots as required
